payload.body_you: {{holder1}} changes the plan after you already moved your day around it. Then it happens again. One surprise is easy to absorb; repeated changes start costing you time.
payload.body_they: You change the time, cancel, or decide you need a different plan after {{holder1}} has already arranged their day. {{holder1}} may be less upset by the change itself than by always being the person expected to adjust.
